deployment_id.description: DeploymentID is the ledger row this run reports its progress against.

app_id.description: AppID is the application being deployed.

image_ref.description:
ImageRef is the image reference as requested, before the digest is
resolved at pull time.

triggered_by.description: TriggeredBy records what caused the deployment.

triggered_by_user_id.description:
TriggeredByUserID is the user who asked for the deployment. It is empty
for a webhook, which nobody triggers by hand.

description: DeployArgsV1 is the v1 payload of the deployment.run job.
